title: Secure Document Retrieval System
business: A document management platform that allows users to download archived reports stored on a server filesystem.
problem: Attackers may manipulate file path parameters using sequences like ../ to escape the intended directory and access sensitive system configuration files or unauthorized data.
solution: Implement path validation by resolving the absolute path of the requested file and verifying that it starts with the designated base directory before any read operation occurs.
steps: Define a strict base directory constant for all accessible files.
Accept the user-provided filename as an untrusted input.
Resolve the canonical path of the combined base directory and user input.
Compare the resolved path against the base directory prefix.
Reject the request if the path is outside the base directory or serve the file if valid.
outcome: The application prevents unauthorized file access while maintaining the ability to serve legitimate user requests.
limitation: Canonicalization can be bypassed if the underlying filesystem or language runtime does not correctly handle symbolic links or specific encoding schemes, requiring periodic security audits of the path resolution logic.
